claim: In full-year 2025, Johnson & Johnson reported gross profit of $63.9 billion and revenue of $105.6 billion.
summary: Full-year 2025 Johnson & Johnson results are beyond the knowledge cutoff and are not established by prior knowledge, so neither the $63.9 billion gross profit nor the $105.6 billion revenue figure can be verified.

sub_claims.text: Johnson & Johnson reported gross profit of $63.9 billion for full-year 2025.
sub_claims.note: Full-year 2025 results postdate knowledge cutoff of 2026-01-04; this gross profit figure is not established by prior knowledge.

sub_claims.text: Johnson & Johnson reported revenue of $105.6 billion for full-year 2025.
sub_claims.note: Full-year 2025 results postdate knowledge cutoff of 2026-01-04; this revenue figure is not established by prior knowledge.
